units.source_text: 小小的偷窃行为，使我变得快活了。

en.t: A small act of theft made me cheerful.

units.source_text: 每次我同柏木结合在一起的时候，

en.t: Whenever I joined together with Kashiwagi,

units.source_text: 总是首先让我招来小小的榜德、小小的渎圣和小小的罪恶，

en.t: it always first brought me small acts of immorality, small acts of sacrilege, and small sins,

units.source_text: 而这些却又照例使我感到快活。

en.t: and these, as usual, made me feel cheerful.

units.source_text: 但是，我不知道我的快活分量是否也随这种罪恶分量的日益增加，

en.t: But I did not know whether the measure of my cheerfulness would also increase as the measure of this sin kept growing,
and whether it would increase without limit.
